header.historical: historical: no spend since 2025-12-20. The last 30 days (2026-09-06 to 2026-10-05) had no spend, and 10 windows of 30 days were checked to find the last active day.
header.rounding: numbers rounded to 2 significant figures; rates computed from unrounded values

results_by_goal.roas: not graded: no purchase value tracked

headline.account_roas: not graded: no purchase value tracked in the window (0 purchases and 0 USD purchase value across all ad groups); see Section 6
headline.delivery: 1 campaign, 1 ad group and 1 ad delivered, all on 2025-12-20; all 120 campaigns are switched off now.

creative_funnel.first_break: Directional only: 43 of 420 plays reached 2 seconds (hook rate 9.3% of impressions), and 30% of those stayed to 6 seconds. The hook is the first step that looks weak.
creative_funnel.why_not_graded: 460 impressions, under the 1,000-impression floor, and only 1 ad delivered, so there is no account baseline to grade against.
creative_funnel.goal_note: On a click goal every result is a click, so results per click is always 1 and says nothing about the page.

click_goal.diagnosis: not graded: under the impression floor and under 10 results; ranked after graded ads by CTR (it is the only ad)

findings: Smart+: 0 of 120 campaigns are Smart+ (all are MANUAL), so there is nothing to compare.
Bids: the one delivering ad group used lowest cost (BID_TYPE_NO_BID), with CPC billing. Across all ad groups: 52 lowest cost and 7 with a cap. One bid group delivered, so no comparison.
Learning: 6 results in the last 7 days, under 50, so the ad group had not settled when the campaign was switched off.

Identity: all 38 ads in the account are ad-only posts (a TikTok account identity with dark_post_status ON); 0 Spark Ads that also sit on the profile and 0 custom identities. Spark versus ad-only can't be compared; test it.
Hook types: not tagged, so skipped.
Fatigue: the ad ran 1 day, so fatigue does not apply.
Every age and gender row is under the 1,000-impression floor, so none is graded.
CPC billing: 5 rows with 190 impressions and no clicks show $0 spend, so CPM and spend share by segment would mislead. Compare CTR and results per impression instead.
Regions: 78% of impressions have no region (province -1). The other 100 impressions spread over 30 US states; the largest are listed, none graded.
Region rows with a click on 3 impressions or fewer (3 of them) show CTRs of 33% to 100%: noise at this volume, not a signal.

Targeting setup: the delivering ad group was broad (ages 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, all genders, 1 country), with no interests, behaviours, custom or lookalike audiences and no exclusions. All 59 ad groups in the account are broad, so there is nothing to compare.
The delivering ad group ran on the TikTok placement only, so Pangle can't be graded.
Setup risk for the next launch: 45 of 59 ad groups use automatic placement, and 45 of those include Pangle and the global app bundle. Read Section 4 after the first week of any relaunch.
Device rows (inside the one delivering ad group) are under the floor: directional only.
Delivery happened on 1 day (2025-12-20), so there are no two 7-day periods to compare.
No ad group optimizes for a website conversion (0), so the fail and warn rules don't apply.
One pixel is attached to 2 ad groups, both on lead generation goals that never delivered in the window.
Pixel conversions in the window: 0 (conversion summed over all 59 ad group rows of the Step 2 ad group report).
Event match quality and Events API deduplication can't be read here; check them in TikTok Events Manager before a conversion campaign.
2 lead generation ad groups exist; 0 delivered in the window.
No TikTok Shop linked (0 stores), 0 GMV Max campaigns (product or LIVE) and 0 catalog ads. The gmv_max_report path is untested until a shop is linked.

Ad group daily budget 20 USD (BUDGET_MODE_DYNAMIC_DAILY_BUDGET): scheduled for 1 of the last 7 days, average daily spend 10 USD = 50% of budget. That is neither under-delivering (under 50%) nor capped (95% or more).
Campaign lifetime budget 50 USD: 20% spent after 1 of 11 scheduled days (9.1%), then the campaign was switched off, so delivery stopped.
Month-end forecast: skipped, because the window is historical and that month is over.

top_actions.action: Relaunch with enough volume to grade each ad: at least 1,000 impressions per ad and at least 10 results per ad group.
top_actions.money_at_stake: not estimated: 10 USD spent in the window
top_actions.how_estimated: At the window's CPM of 22 USD, 1,000 impressions cost about 22 USD per ad, before the 10-result floor.
top_actions.evidence: integrated_report_basic ad and ad group level for the window
top_actions.who: do this in TikTok Ads Manager, or with the campaign builder skill

top_actions.action: Run one Spark Ad (a post that also sits on the profile) next to the ad-only posts on the same goal.
top_actions.how_estimated: Not estimated: no Spark Ad has run in the account, so there is no cost per result to set against the ad-only posts. The test itself measures it.
top_actions.evidence: ads_metadata: 38 of 38 ads are ad-only posts
top_actions.who: do this in TikTok Ads Manager

top_actions.action: Before any conversion campaign, confirm the pixel's events in TikTok Events Manager.
top_actions.how_estimated: Not estimated: no ad group optimizes for a website conversion (0), so no spend depends on the pixel yet.
top_actions.evidence: adgroups_metadata: pixel on 2 lead ad groups; integrated_report_basic ad group level: 0 pixel conversions in the window
top_actions.who: do this in TikTok Events Manager

testing_agenda.test: Two new openings for the same video: result or face on screen with text in the first second
testing_agenda.hypothesis: Directional: 43 of 420 plays reached 2 seconds, so the opening loses most viewers
testing_agenda.decides_it: hook rate on at least 1,000 impressions per version

testing_agenda.test: Spark Ad versus ad-only post with the same video and goal
testing_agenda.hypothesis: a post that keeps its likes and follows on the profile earns cheaper clicks
testing_agenda.decides_it: cost per result with at least 10 results each

testing_agenda.test: Automatic placement versus TikTok only, same creative
testing_agenda.hypothesis: Pangle adds cheap impressions but weaker clicks
testing_agenda.decides_it: cost per result and results per impression by placement, each over 1,000 impressions
